target.deduplication: One verified cumulative table snapshot per run; distinct row/slot entries retained even when content-identical.

normalizer_sensitivity_method: OpenML only: remove literal ASCII ( and ) delimiters from cleaned hypothesis while retaining enclosed text; keep reference/language/scorer unchanged. This is a paired diagnostic, not official validation.
limitations: No cross-dataset average or pooled error total.
Selected W&B examples are cross-dataset low-score selection; they do not estimate population prevalence.
Pattern labels overlap. Digit-bearing changed text does not by itself prove a digit error; S/D/I increases are alignment facts, not acoustic causes.
Grouped Earnings has only six parent recordings; chunk counts are not independent validation units.
Unchanged raw reference does not fix n_ref under compound-aware scoring; preserve each run denominator.
Text cannot establish acoustic correctness, reference defects, or a causal effect of reward changes.
